examples.arabic: بده يعرف ايمتى الكلب رح يبلش يحكي عربي
examples.english: He wants to know when the dog will start speaking Arabic.
examples.transliteration: beddo yaaref emta el kaleb rah yballesh yehki aarabi

examples.english: In the end the dog eats all the food.
examples.transliteration: bil akher el kaleb biyakel kel el akel

examples.arabic: الطباخ حكى امشي دغري من عند الكلب
examples.english: The chef says walk straight from the dog.
examples.transliteration: el tabbakh haka imshi deghri min end el kaleb
